# TenantCloud

> TenantCloud is a comprehensive property management platform offering rent collection, tenant screening, lease management, and landlord tools for real estate professionals.

The platform integrates with payment providers like Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, and Stripe, and partners with services like Steadily for landlord insurance and TransUnion for tenant screening. TenantCloud serves landlords, property managers, and tenants with digital tools to streamline rental operations and grow real estate businesses.

## Key Topics

- Property management software
- Online rent collection
- Tenant screening with TransUnion
- Lease agreements and templates
- Landlord insurance through Steadily
- Digital payment integration (Venmo, Zelle, PayPal, Stripe)
- Pet policies and ESA compliance
- California rental laws
- Remote landlord management
- Rental business automation
- Property tax management
- Eviction procedures
- Security deposits
- Fair housing compliance
- Real estate marketing automation
